text: しょうぶの　じゅんびが　できていない　みたい　また　あとに　しよう！

structure.jp: しょうぶの　じゅんびが　できていない　みたい
structure.en: it seems they aren't ready to battle

structure.jp: また　あとに　しよう！

patterns.name: 〜みたいだ
patterns.span: できていない　みたい
patterns.explanation: みたい at the end says that is how things seem, judging from what you see. できていないみたい = 'it seems it isn't done'.

patterns.name: 〜にする
patterns.explanation: にする after a thing means choosing it. しよう is the 'let's' form of する. あとにしよう = 'let's make it later'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb can say that something has been done and stays that way; ていない says it has not. できていない = 'is not ready yet'.
